title: ACCT: Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.42116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In real-world deployments, large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly evolving from single-model invocation toward heterogeneous deployments in which different models are dynamically invoked for inference. When the same context is reused across models, however, each newly selected target model typically has to process it again, repeatedly incurring substantial computational costs. Therefore, we propose ACCT (Asymmetric Cross-LLM Context Transfer), which targets KV cache transfer between models of different scales within the same model family. ACCT transforms the KV cache produced by a source model into sparse KV states that can be directly consumed by a target model, thereby enabling cross-model reuse of context computation and decoupling context computation from downstream inference. translated_title: ACCT：非对称跨大语言模型上下文传输
translated_abstract: 在实际部署中，大语言模型（LLM）系统正日益从单一模型调用演进为异构部署，即动态调用不同模型进行推理。然而，当相同的上下文在不同模型之间复用时，每个新选定的目标模型通常都必须重新处理该上下文，从而反复产生大量的计算成本。因此，我们提出了ACCT（非对称跨大语言模型上下文传输），针对同一模型家族内不同规模模型之间的KV缓存传输。ACCT将源模型生成的KV缓存转换为可被目标模型直接消费的稀疏KV状态，从而实现上下文计算的跨模型复用，并将上下文计算与下游推理解耦。ACCT由三个轻量级组件构成：Cartographer（制图器）为每个目标层和KV头识别与查询相关的上下文token；Al...
tldr: ACCT提出在同一模型家族内不同规模的LLM之间进行KV缓存传输的方法，将源模型的KV缓存转化为目标模型可直接使用的稀疏KV状态，实现上下文计算的跨模型复用，避免目标模型对相同上下文的重复计算。
